manifest.name: Voice Input
manifest.description: 입력창에 마이크 버튼을 추가합니다. 말한 내용을 OpenAI 호환 음성 인식 API(OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, 로컬 Whisper 등)로 받아써서 입력창에 넣습니다. / Adds a microphone button to the composer and dictates through any OpenAI-compatible transcription API.

settings.label: 서버 주소 (API base)
settings.description: 음성 인식 서버의 origin입니다(예: https://api.openai.com). https 화면에서는 https 주소(또는 localhost)만 쓸 수 있고, 스킴을 생략하면 https입니다. / On an https page use https (or localhost).

settings.label: 전사 경로 (Transcription path)
settings.description: /로 시작하는 경로만 씁니다. 비우면 /v1/audio/transcriptions입니다. Groq는 /openai/v1/audio/transcriptions입니다. / Path only, starting with /.

settings.label: API 키 (API key)
settings.description: 서버가 요구하는 키입니다. Authorization: Bearer 헤더로만 보내며, 이 기기에만 평문으로 저장되고 내보내기에서는 제외됩니다. / Sent only as a Bearer header; stored in plain text on this device only.

settings.label: 모델 (Model)
settings.description: 받아쓰기 모델 이름입니다(예: whisper-1). OpenAI, Groq, Mistral 등은 필수입니다. 비우면 보내지 않아 서버 기본값을 씁니다. / Model name; most hosted services require one.

settings.label: 말하는 언어 (Language)
settings.description: ISO 639-1 코드입니다(예: ko, en, ja). 비우면 보내지 않아 서버가 자동 감지합니다. / Empty lets the server detect it.

<script module>
	// Pure helpers for VoiceButton.svelte. scripts/build.mjs inlines this file into the component's <script module>
// (a trusted component can import only `pipaya`, `svelte*` and sibling .svelte files), and the tests import it directly.
// Keep it free of DOM, network and storage access.

const MAX_RECORD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const MIN_RECORD_MS = 400;
const MIN_BLOB_BYTES = 800;
const UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 60 * 1000;

// Preference order. Chrome/Firefox/Edge make webm or ogg (opus), Safari makes mp4. Voxtral accepts them all
// (checked by uploading m4a, webm/opus and wav), so the browser's own format is uploaded as is.
const MIME_CANDIDATES = ['audio/webm;codecs=opus', 'audio/webm', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/ogg;codecs=opus', 'audio/ogg'];

function pickMimeType(isSupported) {
  for (const type of MIME_CANDIDATES) {
    try { if (isSupported(type)) return type; } catch { /* try the next one */ }
  }
  return '';
}

function baseMime(type) {
  return String(type || '').split(';')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}

function extensionFor(type) {
  switch (baseMime(type)) {
    case 'audio/webm': return 'webm';
    case 'audio/mp4': case 'audio/x-m4a': case 'audio/aac': return 'm4a';
    case 'audio/ogg': return 'ogg';
    case 'audio/wav': case 'audio/x-wav': case 'audio/wave': return 'wav';
    case 'audio/mpeg': return 'mp3';
    default: return 'webm';
  }
}

function formatTime(ms) {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  return `${Math.floor(total / 60)}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// Append to what is already typed, separated by one space; never replace the draft.
function joinDraft(current, addition) {
  const add = String(addition ?? '').trim();
  const cur = String(current ?? '');
  if (!add) return cur;
  return cur.trim() ? `${cur.replace(/\s+$/, '')} ${add}` : add;
}

// The extension talks only to the transcription server (`apiBase`), never to the pipaya server. HTTPS matters in two
// places, and only there:
//  1. The microphone (`getUserMedia`) needs the page to be a secure context (checked by the component).
//  2. A page opened over https cannot call an `http://` server (mixed content), so on such a page a plain-http address is
//     refused. The exception is a loopback host (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]): browsers treat these as trustworthy and let
//     an https page call them, which is what a Whisper server on the same machine needs. Private-network addresses are not
//     an exception here (see README).
// On a page that is not https (an http page, or localhost) a plain-http address is fine.
function isLoopbackHost(hostname) {
  const h = String(hostname ?? '').toLowerCase();
  return h === 'localhost' || h.endsWith('.localhost') || h === '[::1]' || /^127(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}$/.test(h);
}

// An address typed without a scheme (`api.example.com`, `localhost:8000`) is read as https://. The stored value is not
// changed; only the reading is. Anything that already has a scheme is left alone.
function withScheme(text) {
  const t = String(text ?? '').trim();
  if (!t || /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(t)) return t;
  // `host:port` also looks like `scheme:path`, so only a `scheme://` counts as a scheme here; other `x:y` forms fall through
  // to URL() below and are rejected as malformed.
  if (/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:(?!\d+(?:\/|$))/i.test(t)) return t;
  return `https://${t}`;
}

// Splits what the user typed into { origin, problem }. `problem` is '' (fine), 'needBase' (empty or not an origin:
// path, query, credentials, other scheme) or 'needHttps' (a well-formed http:// address, on an https page, that is not
// loopback). `pageProtocol` is `location.protocol` of the page ('https:' / 'http:' / ...); when it is left out the
// strict reading is used, as if the page were https. A missing scheme means https (see withScheme).
function checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  const text = withScheme(apiBase);
  if (!text) return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  let url;
  try { url = new URL(text); } catch { return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' }; }
  if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && url.protocol !== 'http:') return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  if (url.username || url.password || url.search || url.hash || !/^\/*$/.test(url.pathname)) return { origin: '', problem: 'needBase' };
  if (url.protocol === 'http:' && pageProtocol === 'https:' && !isLoopbackHost(url.hostname)) return { origin: '', problem: 'needHttps' };
  return { origin: url.origin, problem: '' };
}

// The bare origin to send to, or '' when the setting must not be used (see checkBase).
function originOf(apiBase, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  return checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol).origin;
}

// The standard OpenAI-style route. It is only the default of the `transcribePath` setting; servers that mount
// the same API elsewhere (a prefix, a gateway route) change the setting instead of the code.
const DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_PATH = '/v1/audio/transcriptions';

// A request path only: starts with one `/`, no scheme, origin, query, fragment, `..`/`.` segments, backslashes,
// spaces or control characters. Empty means the default. Returns '' when the value is not acceptable.
function pathOf(transcribePath) {
  const text = transcribePath === undefined || transcribePath === null ? '' : String(transcribePath).trim();
  if (!text) return DEFAULT_TRANSCRIBE_PATH;
  if (text.length > 200 || !/^\/(?!\/)[A-Za-z0-9._~\-\/%:@!$&'()*+,;=]*$/.test(text)) return '';
  if (text.split('/').some((part) => part === '.' || part === '..' || /^(%2e)+$/i.test(part))) return '';
  return text;
}

// origin + path, or '' when either part is not acceptable (then nothing is sent).
function endpoint(apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol = 'https:') {
  const origin = originOf(apiBase, pageProtocol);
  const path = pathOf(transcribePath);
  if (!origin || !path) return '';
  try { if (new URL(origin + path).origin !== origin) return ''; } catch { return ''; }
  return origin + path;
}

function hostOf(apiBase) {
  try { return new URL(String(apiBase)).host; } catch { return String(apiBase ?? ''); }
}

// context_bias is deliberately never sent: the server adds its stored term list.
function buildForm(blob, { model, language }) {
  const form = new FormData();
  const type = baseMime(blob.type) || 'audio/webm';
  form.append('file', new File([blob], `voice.${extensionFor(type)}`, { type }));
  const m = String(model ?? '').trim();
  if (m) form.append('model', m);
  const l = String(language ?? '').trim();
  if (l) form.append('language', l);
  return form;
}

class VoiceError extends Error {
  constructor(kind, status) {
    super(kind);
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = status;
  }
}

// One upload. The key goes only into the Authorization header and never into a message or log.
// Throws VoiceError(kind) with kind in needBase | needHttps | badPath | notFound | aborted | timeout | network | badKey | rateLimited | tooBig | serverError | badResponse | empty.
async function transcribe({ fetchImpl, apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol = 'https:', apiKey, model, language, blob, timeoutMs = UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS, signal }) {
  const base = checkBase(apiBase, pageProtocol);
  if (base.problem) throw new VoiceError(base.problem);
  if (!pathOf(transcribePath)) throw new VoiceError('badPath');
  const control = new AbortController();
  let timedOut = false;
  const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; control.abort(); }, timeoutMs);
  const onAbort = () => control.abort();
  if (signal) { if (signal.aborted) control.abort(); else signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true }); }
  try {
    let response;
    try {
      response = await fetchImpl(endpoint(apiBase, transcribePath, pageProtocol), {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
        body: buildForm(blob, { model, language }),
        credentials: 'omit',
        referrerPolicy: 'no-referrer',
        redirect: 'error',
        signal: control.signal
      });
    } catch {
      throw new VoiceError(timedOut ? 'timeout' : control.signal.aborted ? 'aborted' : 'network');
    }
    if (!response.ok) throw new VoiceError(httpErrorKind(response.status), response.status);
    let body;
    try { body = await response.json(); } catch { throw new VoiceError(timedOut ? 'timeout' : control.signal.aborted ? 'aborted' : 'badResponse'); }
    if (typeof body?.text !== 'string') throw new VoiceError('badResponse');
    const text = body.text.trim();
    if (!text) throw new VoiceError('empty');
    return text;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
  }
}

function micErrorKind(error) {
  switch (error?.name) {
    case 'NotAllowedError': case 'PermissionDeniedError': case 'SecurityError': return 'micDenied';
    case 'NotFoundError': case 'DevicesNotFoundError': case 'OverconstrainedError': return 'noMic';
    case 'NotReadableError': case 'TrackStartError': case 'AbortError': return 'micBusy';
    default: return 'micFailed';
  }
}

function httpErrorKind(status) {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return 'badKey';
  if (status === 404 || status === 405) return 'notFound';
  if (status === 429) return 'rateLimited';
  if (status === 413) return 'tooBig';
  return 'serverError';
}

function message(lang, key, params = {}) {
  const table = STRINGS[String(lang || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('ko') ? 'ko' : 'en'];
  return String(table[key] ?? STRINGS.en[key] ?? key).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (m, k) => (k in params ? String(params[k]) : m));
}

	// A key the server refused stays refused until the stored key changes: some servers (CLIProxyAPI, for one) block
	// an IP for a while after a few rejected requests, so a wrong key is never retried.
	let rejectedKey = "";
</script>

<script>
	// Microphone button next to the send control (mounted by VoiceSend.svelte). Click: record. Click again: stop, upload to the CLIProxyAPI
	// mistral-support route (Mistral Voxtral) and append the transcript to the draft. It never sends the message.
	import { onDestroy } from "svelte";
	import { ext, app, getPane } from "pipaya";

	// `offline`: the app has no server connection (its input box is dimmed then), so there is nothing to type into.
	let { offline = false } = $props();
	const pane = getPane();
	const lang = $derived(ext.language);
	const tr = (key, params) => message(lang, key, params);

	let phase = $state("idle"); // idle | starting | recording | transcribing
	let elapsed = $state(0);
	let notice = $state(null); // { text, short }
	let root = $state();

	let stream = null;
	let recorder = null;
	let chunks = [];
	let mime = "";
	let intent = "send"; // what to do when the recorder stops: send | cancel
	let startedAt = 0;
	let tick;
	let hardStop;
	let noticeTimer;
	let upload = null;
	let token = 0;
	let gone = false;

	const busy = $derived(phase === "starting" || phase === "transcribing");
	// While recording or working the button must stay usable to stop; only an idle button is blocked offline.
	const insecure = typeof window !== "undefined" && !window.isSecureContext;
	const blocked = $derived(busy || (offline && phase === "idle"));

	function say(key, params) {
		clearTimeout(noticeTimer);
		const text = tr(key, params);
		notice = { text, short: tr(`${key}Short`) };
		app.toast(text, "error");
		noticeTimer = setTimeout(() => { notice = null; }, 9000);
	}
	function clearNotice() { clearTimeout(noticeTimer); notice = null; }

	function release() {
		clearInterval(tick);
		clearTimeout(hardStop);
		if (stream) for (const track of stream.getTracks()) { track.onended = null; try { track.stop(); } catch { /* already stopped */ } }
		stream = null;
	}

	function reset() {
		release();
		recorder = null;
		chunks = [];
		phase = "idle";
	}

	async function begin() {
		clearNotice();
		const settings = ext.settings ?? {};
		// The page must be a secure context before anything else: without it the microphone cannot start at all.
		if (!window.isSecureContext) return say("insecure");
		const base = checkBase(settings.apiBase, location.protocol);
		if (base.problem) {
			say(base.problem);
			app.openSettings?.("extensions");
			return;
		}
		if (!pathOf(settings.transcribePath)) {
			say("badPath");
			app.openSettings?.("extensions");
			return;
		}
		const key = String(settings.apiKey ?? "").trim();
		if (!key) {
			say("needKey");
			app.openSettings?.("extensions");
			return;
		}
		if (key === rejectedKey) return say("badKey", { status: 401 });
		if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || typeof MediaRecorder === "undefined") return say("unsupported");

		const mine = ++token;
		phase = "starting";
		let media;
		try {
			media = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: { echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true } });
		} catch (error) {
			if (mine === token && !gone) { phase = "idle"; say(micErrorKind(error)); }
			return;
		}
		// Unmounted or cancelled while the permission prompt was open: close the stream at once.
		if (gone || mine !== token) { for (const track of media.getTracks()) track.stop(); return; }
		stream = media;
		try {
			mime = pickMimeType((type) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(type));
			recorder = new MediaRecorder(media, mime ? { mimeType: mime } : undefined);
		} catch {
			reset();
			return say("unsupported");
		}
		const rec = recorder;
		chunks = [];
		intent = "send";
		rec.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data?.size) chunks.push(event.data); };
		rec.onerror = () => { intent = "cancel"; reset(); say("micFailed"); };
		rec.onstop = () => void finish(rec, mine);
		// The microphone was unplugged or revoked: finish with what was captured.
		for (const track of media.getAudioTracks()) track.onended = () => stop();
		rec.start(1000);
		startedAt = performance.now();
		elapsed = 0;
		phase = "recording";
		tick = setInterval(() => { elapsed = performance.now() - startedAt; }, 250);
		hardStop = setTimeout(stop, MAX_RECORD_MS);
	}

	function stop(next = "send") {
		if (phase !== "recording" || !recorder) return;
		intent = next;
		elapsed = performance.now() - startedAt;
		if (recorder.state !== "inactive") { try { recorder.stop(); } catch { /* handled by onstop/onerror */ } }
	}

	async function finish(rec, mine) {
		const length = performance.now() - startedAt;
		const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: rec.mimeType || mime || "audio/webm" });
		const wanted = intent;
		reset(); // the microphone is closed before the upload starts
		if (gone || mine !== token || wanted === "cancel") return;
		if (length < MIN_RECORD_MS || blob.size < MIN_BLOB_BYTES) return say("tooShort");
		await send(blob);
	}

	async function send(blob) {
		const settings = ext.settings ?? {};
		const key = String(settings.apiKey ?? "").trim();
		const base = String(settings.apiBase ?? "").trim();
		const paneId = pane.id;
		phase = "transcribing";
		upload = new AbortController();
		try {
			const text = await transcribe({
				fetchImpl: (url, init) => fetch(url, init),
				apiBase: base,
				transcribePath: settings.transcribePath,
				pageProtocol: location.protocol,
				apiKey: key,
				model: settings.model,
				language: settings.language,
				blob,
				signal: upload.signal
			});
			if (gone) return;
			phase = "idle";
			insert(text, paneId);
		} catch (error) {
			if (gone) return;
			phase = "idle";
			const kind = error?.kind ?? "network";
			if (kind === "aborted") return;
			if (kind === "badKey") rejectedKey = key;
			if (kind === "needBase" || kind === "needHttps" || kind === "badPath") app.openSettings?.("extensions");
			say(kind, { status: error?.status ?? "", host: hostOf(base), sec: Math.round(UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000) });
		} finally {
			upload = null;
		}
	}

	function insert(text, paneId) {
		// Another chat took the input box meanwhile: do not put the words into the wrong draft.
		if (pane.id !== paneId) return say("paneChanged", { text });
		const box = root?.closest('[data-part="composer"]')?.querySelector("textarea[data-composer]");
		if (!box) {
			app.prefill = text; // the app appends it to the draft
			return;
		}
		const value = joinDraft(box.value, text);
		Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, "value").set.call(box, value);
		box.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); // keeps the composer's own state in step
		// On a phone, focusing would pop the keyboard up over the result.
		if (!matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) box.focus({ preventScroll: true });
		try { box.setSelectionRange(value.length, value.length); } catch { /* not focusable */ }
	}

	function onclick() {
		if (phase === "recording") stop();
		else if (phase === "idle") void begin();
	}

	onDestroy(() => {
		gone = true;
		token++;
		clearTimeout(noticeTimer);
		intent = "cancel";
		if (recorder && recorder.state !== "inactive") { try { recorder.stop(); } catch { /* closing anyway */ } }
		upload?.abort();
		release();
	});

	const label = $derived(insecure && phase === "idle" ? tr("insecure") : phase === "recording" ? tr("recording") : phase === "transcribing" ? tr("transcribing") : tr("idle"));
</script>

<div class="vi" bind:this={root} data-state={phase}>
	<span class="status" role="status" aria-live="polite">
		{#if phase === "recording"}
			<span class="chip live"><i class="dot"></i>{formatTime(elapsed)}</span>
			<button type="button" class="iconbtn sm cancel" aria-label={tr("cancel")} title={tr("cancel")} onclick={() => stop("cancel")}>
				<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
			</button>
		{:else if phase === "transcribing"}
			<span class="chip">{tr("transcribingShort")}</span>
		{:else if notice}
			<span class="chip bad" title={notice.text}>{notice.short}</span>
		{/if}
	</span>

	<button
		type="button"
		class="iconbtn mic"
		class:rec={phase === "recording"}
		class:err={!!notice && phase === "idle"}
		class:unavailable={insecure}
		aria-disabled={insecure || undefined}
		aria-label={label}
		aria-pressed={phase === "recording"}
		title={label}
		disabled={blocked}
		{onclick}
	>
		{#if phase === "recording"}
			<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="solid" x="7" y="7" width="10" height="10" rx="2" /></svg>
		{:else if busy}
			<svg class="spin" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 9 9" /></svg>
		{:else}
			<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v6a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V6a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z" /><path d="M19 11a7 7 0 0 1-14 0M12 18v3" /></svg>
		{/if}
	</button>
</div>

<style>
	/* The status chip opens to the left of the microphone, so the microphone stays beside the send control and the
	   chip is what gives way (clipped) when the bar is narrow, never the send control. */
	.vi { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; flex: 0 1 auto; }
	.status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
	.mic { flex: none; }
	.mic.rec { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
	.mic.err { color: var(--danger); }
	/* Not a real disabled state: the button stays clickable so that pressing it explains why it cannot record. */
	.mic.unavailable { opacity: 0.5; }
	.mic:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: default; }
	.mic .solid { fill: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; }
	.spin { animation: vi-spin 0.9s linear infinite; }
	.chip { flex: 0 1 auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 9em; padding: 0 4px; overflow: hidden; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text-dim); white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
	.chip.live { color: var(--danger); }
	.chip.bad { color: var(--danger); }
	.dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--danger); animation: vi-pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
	.cancel { color: var(--text-faint); }
	@keyframes vi-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
	@keyframes vi-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }
	@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .spin, .dot { animation: none; } }
	@media (max-width: 480px) { .chip { max-width: 5.5em; padding: 0 2px; font-size: var(--fs-xs); } }
</style>
